atoms.title: Strings
atoms.b: In the past, strings were made of animal intestine or plant fibers. Nowadays, strings are usually made of metal or synthetic material.
The thinner a string is, the higher the pitch it plays. The thicker the string, the lower the pitch.
The length of the string is also important. The shorter the string, the higher the pitch it plays. The longer the string, the lower the pitch.
Large instruments like the double bass have ((++long short)), ((thin ++thick)) strings, and therefore a lower sound. Smaller instruments such as the violin have shorter, thinner strings.

atoms.a: What are instrument strings usually made of nowadays?

atoms.a: What do you think happens when you press a string down with your finger, thus shortening the length that vibrates?

end.text: The tone played is higher, since the string is shorter.
